shortDescription.default: Play chess against Stockfish Lite — a real chess engine that runs in your browser via WebAssembly

longDescription.default: Play chess against Stockfish Lite, a real chess engine compiled to WebAssembly that runs entirely in your browser. Choose from 7 difficulty levels, from novice to grandmaster. Games are saved to a SharePoint list so you can reload, review, and delete them at any time.
